conv.file: Row of the .raw conversion panel: {i} = number of the file being converted, {n} = how many .raw files in all, {name} = file name.
conv.detail.scans: Numbers below the conversion bar: {done} = scans converted, {total} = scans in the file.
conv.detail.indexed: Numbers below the bar during indexing: {done} = files indexed, {total} = files, {elapsed} = elapsed time (m:ss).
conv.beat.indexing: Message next to the "Preparing the files" stage when no news arrives for 2 seconds.
conv.detail.written: Numbers below the conversion bar: {mb} = MB of mzML written so far.
conv.detail.elapsed: Numbers below the conversion bar: {elapsed} = elapsed time (m:ss).
conv.detail.handover: Numbers below the bar when the desktop app hands the mzML over to the page: {done}/{total} = MB handed over and total, {elapsed} = elapsed time.
conv.detail.wait: Numbers below the bar before the scans, while the file is being opened; {elapsed} = elapsed time (m:ss).
conv.st.engine: Status of a dropped file in the side list while the calculation engine is still starting (the file is waiting, nothing has failed).
conv.row.engine: Same state, long form read by the screen-reader status region: the file waits for the calculation engine to start.
conv.row.run: Row of a .wiff sample in the file list while it is being converted; {pc} = conversion percentage.
conv.row.index: Row of a .wiff sample in the file list while it is being indexed; {pc} = percentage.
conv.row.nread: Row of a sample in the file list while the vendor files are being read (fingerprint calculation); {pc} = percentage.
conv.row.nscan: Row of a sample in the file list while the scan index is being built; {pc} = percentage.
conv.row.nchrom: Row of a sample in the file list while the chromatograms are being calculated; {pc} = percentage.
conv.row.nopen: Row of a sample in the file list while the reader opens the vendor file (the scan table of all samples); {pc} = percentage.
conv.row.getmb: Row of a file in the list while it is downloaded from the site (example file): {done} and {total} are the MB downloaded and total.
conv.row.loadmb: Row of a file in the list while it is copied into the browser memory: {done} and {total} are the MB copied and total.
conv.row.readn: Row of a file in the list while the scans are read: {done} scans read out of {total}.
conv.row.ready: Summary at the top of the list being loaded: {done} files ready out of {n}, {time} = elapsed time (m:ss).
conv.row.scans: Addition to the row of a sample during indexing: {done} scans read out of {total} of the sample.
conv.row.done: Outcome that stays on the row of a loaded sample; {read} = scans read of the sample, {secs} = seconds taken.
conv.row.cached: Outcome on the row of a sample already loaded with the same .wiff and .wiff.scan (same names, sizes and dates): nothing is copied or read again; {read} = scans read of the sample.
conv.row.missing: Warning on the row of a sample loaded from a truncated copy (.wiff.scan, mzML); {n} = scans declared by the file or its list but beyond the end of the data.
conv.row.noEvent: Warning on the row of a .raw whose scan event table cannot be read: all the scans are there; {n} = scans without an event, {read} = scans read of the sample. Do not say that the file ends.
conv.row.damaged: Warning on the row of a file with damaged scans (in a .raw, an index entry beyond the end of the file or a packet that does not decode; in any format, scan data that do not decode): the scan row stays, without points; {n} = damaged scans, {read} = scans of the sample. Do not say that the file ends or that it is rejected.
conv.row.leftOut: Warning on the row of an Agilent .D folder with damaged scan records: their scans are not in the list; {n} = scans left out, {read} = read, {declared} = declared. Do not say that the file ends.
conv.row.noCalibration: Warning on the row of a .d folder with frames without m/z calibration: their spectra are not in the list; {n} = left out, {read} = read, {declared} = declared. Do not say that the file ends.
conv.q.fail: Next to the file in the list, in the desktop app: the background conversion to mzML failed; {msg} = short cause.
conv.q.saved: Notice after "Save the mzML files…" in the desktop app; {n} = mzML files put in the chosen folder.
conv.q.kept: Notice after "Save the mzML files…" in the desktop app; {names} = the file names left alone because a different file with that name is already in the chosen folder.
conv.q.own: Notice after "Save the mzML files…" in the desktop app; {names} = the file names saved under their own name because the name asked for is not a bare .mzML file name.
conv.sum.head: Totals row below the loaded files, once loading is finished; {n} = files finished, {parts} = the list of counts (conv.sum.* keys), {time} = time from the first start to the last end (m:ss).
conv.sum.full: Count in the summary: {n} = full scan files loaded.
conv.sum.ms2: Count in the summary: {n} = MS2 (product ion) files loaded.
conv.sum.mrm: Count in the summary: {n} = MRM files loaded.
conv.sum.infusion: Count in the summary: {n} = infusion files loaded.
conv.sum.mixed: Count in the summary: {n} = files with several parts (for example full scan and MS2) loaded.
conv.sum.other: Count in the summary: {n} = files loaded of another type (for example empty).
conv.sum.fail: Count in the summary: {n} = files not loaded because of an error.
conv.sum.cancel: Count in the summary: {n} = files stopped with "Cancel".
conv.sum.cached: Count in the summary: {n} = files taken from the browser cache without reading them again.
conv.sum.missing: Count in the summary: {n} = files loaded with a partial read (truncated file, or .raw with scans lacking their event): do not say that the file ends.
conv.help.hint: Sentence above the 5 steps of the "No mzML files?" guide when the user has just loaded files that cannot be opened; {types} = extensions, e.g. ".raw, .wiff".
conv.fmt.mzml: Item of the download menu: the converted file as plain mzML (the format name, not translated).
conv.fmt.numpress: Item of the download menu: the converted file as mzML with MS-Numpress compression (the format name, not translated).
